motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Arrivals, presses, reveals, link underline, arrow nudge, check-mark drawing, step cross-fade.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Skyline line drawings and the scroll cue.

motion.name: hover-color
motion.purpose: Colour, border and background state changes.

motion.name: link-underline
motion.purpose: Underline grows from the right edge on link hover.

motion.name: button-sheen
motion.purpose: One white sheen sweep across a button on hover (fine pointers only).

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.value: lines 1100ms stagger 0/90/170ms; copy opacity+translateY(18px) 900ms from 280ms in 110ms steps
motion.purpose: The only load-time entrance; fires once after fonts are ready (max 1.2s).

motion.name: statement-word
motion.value: color 400ms ease; words from 18% ivory to ivory (key words to gold) by scroll position

motion.name: journey-scrub
motion.value: 520vh pinned; path stroke-dashoffset = 1 - p/0.75; step cross-fade 500ms ease-out with 6px blur and 16px travel
motion.purpose: Pinned scroll-scrubbed journey; path reaches the key at 75% of scroll.

motion.name: key-arrival
motion.value: stroke to pale champagne 400ms, key-glow 600ms, ring scale 1 to 3.2 over 1400ms ease-out once
motion.purpose: Reward on the final journey step.

motion.name: gallery-scrub
motion.value: 560vh pinned; translate3d by scroll; 1px gold progress rule scaleX from right
motion.purpose: Pinned horizontal destinations gallery on desktop; swipe carousel with mandatory snap on touch.

motion.name: line-draw-skyline
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset 1800ms ease-in-out, paths staggered 200ms, at 35% visibility, once

motion.name: globe
motion.value: sway 4deg over a 9s sine; arcs 1.5s each in a 7s cycle staggered 380ms; marker pulse ~3.8s; pointer tilt eased 0.04 per frame
motion.purpose: Hero canvas globe; paused off screen and in hidden tabs; one still complete frame under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: scroll-behavior auto; animations instant; statement lit; drawings complete; globe still; journey steps fade 200ms without blur or travel
motion.purpose: All content present and readable without motion.

narrative.overview:
Classic luxury real estate, executed straight: a deep night-navy ground, champagne-gold line work, ivory type. The page is one continuous crossing from Tel Aviv to a key in the investor's hand, and every surface behaves like a chart drawn in gold ink on a dark sea. Gold is drawn, never poured: it arrives as hairlines, strokes, outlines and single emphasised words, and only the primary button is a solid gold field.

Density is low and the pace is slow. Sections are separated by tall vertical rhythm and hairline rules, not by boxes. The Hebrew serif carries every headline at large scale and light weight; the Hebrew sans carries reading and action. Motion is scroll-led and deliberate in the manner of Apple product pages: the hero enters once, a statement lights word by word, the journey is pinned and scrubbed until the key lights, the destinations travel sideways under a pinned frame, and line drawings ink themselves once. Nothing is hidden from a visitor who reduces motion.

The layout is mirrored for right-to-left reading throughout: text holds the right (start) side, visuals sit opposite on the left, arrows point left to mean "forward", progress fills from the right.
keyCharacteristics: Night-navy ground in three close tones; no light sections.
Gold as line, not fill: hairlines, SVG strokes, outlines, one gold phrase per headline.
Frank Ruhl Libre display at light weight over Heebo body, both Hebrew-native.
Hairline-ruled lists instead of cards; one framed panel type only (the country panel and the form).
Near-square corners (2px) everywhere except chips (pill) and step numbers (circle).
Scroll-driven, once-only motion on two custom easings; full content under reduced motion.
Visible slots for every fact not yet supplied; nothing invented.

rules.name: The Gold Is Drawn Rule
rules.body: Gold appears as stroke, outline, hairline or a single emphasised phrase. The only solid gold surfaces are the primary button and the skip link. No gold section backgrounds, no gold cards, no gold gradients as fills (the faint gold radial behind the hero and the 7% gold tint at the top of a country panel are the ceiling).

rules.name: The One Gold Phrase Rule
rules.body: A headline carries at most one gold span, and it is the payoff ("בחו״ל", "ההזדמנות נמצאת מעבר לים", "הכל כולל הכל"). In display type the gold span is bolder than its line (700 against 300).

rules.name: The Night Only Rule
rules.body: Every section sits on one of the three navies. Depth between sections is made by switching navy tone or by a gradient from one navy to another, never by a light band.

rules.name: The Light Serif Rule
rules.body: Display and statement serif type is set at 300; headlines at 400. Weight is reserved for the single gold phrase. Never set a serif headline in 600 or above.

rules.name: The Large Body Rule
rules.body: Body text never drops below 17px and keeps 1.65 line height. The audience includes older investors reading Hebrew on phones.

rules.name: The Flat Night Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. A glow is earned by arrival (the key), never applied to a resting element.

dos: Do keep every section on Night Navy, Harbor Navy or Dusk Navy, with Ivory for headlines and Mist for reading text.
Do draw gold: hairlines, 1.6 to 2.5px SVG strokes with round caps, outlines, and at most one gold phrase per headline.
Do separate content with hairline rules (Gold Hairline structural, Ivory Hairline quiet) instead of cards.
Do set serif headlines light (300 display, 400 headline) and let the gold phrase carry the weight.
Do mirror for RTL: text at the start (right), visuals opposite, arrows pointing left for forward, progress filling from the right.
Do use the authored SVG arrow and SVG chevron; never a text glyph.
Do use the two custom easings and once-only reveals for drawings; keep hover effects behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
Do mark every missing fact as a slot (`data-slot`, dotted underline, comment) and keep the form honest about whether it sends.
Do keep all content readable and present with reduced motion: no element may depend on an animation to become visible.
donts: Don't introduce light or white sections, or gold-filled panels; the primary button is the only solid gold.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, buttons or panels; the key glow is the only glow.
Don't nest framed panels; the country panel and the form are the only framed containers.
Don't round corners beyond 2px except chips (pill) and stations (circle).
Don't fade sections in on scroll; the hero entrance is the only load entrance and drawings are the only scroll reveals.
Don't set body text below 17px or wider than about 46ch.
Don't put a small label or eyebrow above a heading; the Latin caption belongs only beneath a country name.
Don't invent project names, prices, returns, counts or testimonials to fill a slot.
Don't treat the "MS" box wordmark or this palette as final brand: the real logo and msgp.co.il colours override them when supplied.
